title: Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort to Debut Five New Culinary Concepts With January 2027 Opening
summary: Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort today announced five new culinary concepts designed to celebrate Florida’s Paradise Coast.

Listen to this article


0:00


The transformed Florida Gulf Coast resort will introduce distinct food and beverage experiences designed to connect travelers and locals with the creativity, culture and energy of Naples


- Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort will unveil five new culinary concepts when the reimagined resort welcomes guests in January 2027, introducing a diverse collection of dining experiences inspired by Naples and Florida’s Paradise Coast.
- The new lineup includes Spoonbill, Solfina Bar and Terrace, Vicolo Social Club and Trattoria, Cocoplum Pool Bar and Flipside Beach Bar, spanning from an all-day café and coastal Mediterranean bar to modern Italian dining and relaxed poolside and beachfront experiences.
- The culinary transformation is part of the resort’s broader property-wide revitalization, which encompasses all 474 guest accommodations, dining, wellness and gathering spaces, with Chef Asif Syed leading the reimagined food and beverage program as Director of Culinary.


**NAPLES, Fla.** —[Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort](http://naplesgrande.com/) today announced five new culinary concepts designed to celebrate the flavors, spirit and natural beauty of Florida’s Paradise Coast. The concepts will debut when the resort officially welcomes guests in January 2027, following a sweeping, property-wide transformation.


Spanning an all-day café and marketplace, a coastal Mediterranean bar and terrace, a modern Italian social club and trattoria, a vibrant pool bar, and a nostalgic beachfront eatery, the new collection of culinary venues is a diverse lineup of food and beverage experiences. Each is a dynamic destination in its own right, bringing fresh energy, flavor and connection to the beloved Gulf Coast resort.


Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort


The five concepts are designed as vibrant spaces for dining, gathering and socializing, including **Spoonbill** café and marketplace **, Solfina Bar and Terrace, Vicolo Social Club and Trattoria, Cocoplum Pool Bar** and **Flipside Beach Bar.**


“Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort is undergoing an exciting transformation, with a reimagined culinary program designed to bring people together through moments of connection, discovery and celebration,” said Gary Sims, vice president managing director, Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort. “Each of these five concepts pairs its own personality and culinary point of view with a distinct sense of place, creating new ways for our guests and the local community to gather, connect and celebrate the spirit of Naples. We can’t wait to bring each concept to life, alongside the signature hospitality of Signia Hilton, when we reopen in January.”


#### **Culinary highlights include:**


- **Spoonbill:** Named for the iconic roseate spoonbill bird native to Florida’s wetlands, **Spoonbill** will be the resort’s new lobby-level café and marketplace, welcoming guests with a bright, colorful and airy setting from morning through evening.


A dedicated pastry chef will lead a made-in-house pastry program, complemented by freshly prepared sandwiches, salads, fresh-pressed juices and wellness-focused offerings throughout the day. As night falls, the café will shift into a casual destination for ice cream and affogatos, while a curated selection of retail items invites guests to linger and browse.


Whether they stop in for a quick but satisfying breakfast, a light midday lunch, an impromptu coffee meeting or to satisfy an evening sweet tooth, guests will find Spoonbill to be an energizing and convenient gathering spot in the heart of the resort.


- **Solfina Bar and Terrace:** Reimagining the resort’s signature lobby bar, **Solfina Bar and Terrace** will be a new social hub, evoking the effortless allure of coastal living. An inviting indoor-outdoor setting will blend lush botanicals and earthy design elements with a subtly moody ambiance, while a citrus-forward menu will draw inspiration from the sun-drenched flavors of the Mediterranean.


Neapolitan pizzas, crudo and shareable plates will pair with classic cocktails, including Negronis and Spritzes. Solfina Bar and Terrace will offer a show-stopping lobby bar, alongside a mix of communal and intimate seating. Casual yet polished, the concept will capture a fresh expression of luxury and serve as the social heartbeat of the resort.


- **Vicolo Social Club and Trattoria:** Vicolo Social Club and Trattoria will be the final addition to Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort’s new collection of dining experiences.


Conceived as a modern Italian social club, Vicolo will bring a lively, stylish energy to the resort’s dining scene. A buzzing, dynamic atmosphere will invite guests to celebrate and savor the moment, as music, lighting and attentive service set the stage for an unforgettable evening.


The menu will spotlight house-made pastas, a dedicated steak program and tableside service, complemented by martinis and creative cocktails from a chic new bar. Bold in character and generous in spirit, Vicolo will offer a fresh take on Italian dining and become a distinctive gathering place within the resort.


- **Cocoplum Pool Bar:** Inspired by the colors and laid-back spirit of Florida, the Caribbean and the Mediterranean, **Cocoplum Pool Bar** will bring a fresh food and beverage experience to the pool deck.


An open-concept kitchen and bar will anchor a relaxed setting, offering a lighter menu of approachable poolside favorites, such as burgers and fresh salads. Frozen cocktails, crisp wines and champagne will round out the menu, making Cocoplum the colorful, quintessential poolside setting for everything from a casual lunch between swims to an enjoyable afternoon in the sun.


- **Flipside Beach Bar:** Just steps from the Gulf, **Flipside Beach Bar** will offer a casual retro-inspired take on the classic, toes-in-the-sand beach bar. Designed for easygoing days in the sun, the fast-casual concept will serve smash burgers, crispy fries, sandwiches and other beach-side favorites, alongside frozen drinks, buckets of beer and canned cocktails.


Guests can settle in for a laid-back meal or grab food and drinks to take with them to the sugar-white sands of Clam Pass Beach. Fun, approachable and intentionally relaxed, Flipside Beach Bar will be the go-to spot for a quick bite, cold drink and everything in between.


## **A New Culinary Chapter for Signa Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort**


The debut of these five new concepts marks a significant chapter for Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort and follows the recent appointment of acclaimed Florida chef, restaurateur and culinary personality **Chef Asif Syed** as Director of Culinary. In his new role, Chef Asif will lead the resort’s reimagined food and beverage program, bringing together the five new concepts as part of a broader culinary vision for the revitalized property.


Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort - Guest Room


The comprehensive transformation spans all 474 guest accommodations, dining, wellness and gathering spaces, setting the stage for a new chapter at one of Southwest Florida’s iconic beachfront resorts.

The resort will introduce five distinct culinary concepts: Spoonbill, Solfina Bar and Terrace, Vicolo Social Club and Trattoria, Cocoplum Pool Bar and Flipside Beach Bar, offering guests new experiences throughout the resort from morning to night.


The collection will offer distinctive venues for a range of occasions, from an all-day café and marketplace and modern Italian dining to a coastal Mediterranean-inspired bar, relaxed poolside dining and a casual beachfront concept. Drawing inspiration from Naples and Florida’s Paradise Coast, each concept will bring its own culinary point of view and sense of place.


Chef Asif Syed, Director of Culinary, will lead the resort’s reimagined food and beverage program, bringing his experience as an acclaimed Florida chef and restaurateur to the resort’s new culinary chapter.

## About Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort


Set among lush mangrove forests on Florida’s Paradise Coast, Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort is a 474-room retreat offering direct access to three miles of white sand beach. The iconic beachfront resort is currently undergoing a transformative, property-wide revitalization that will debut in early 2027, ushering in a new era of modern coastal luxury. The comprehensive reimagination will refresh guest accommodations, dining venues, public spaces and select meetings and event offerings while honoring the timeless beauty and natural surroundings of Naples. The resort features an extensive collection of indoor and outdoor meeting and event space, multiple dining outlets and a full-service spa, making it a premier destination for leisure travelers, groups and special events. For more information, visit[www.naplesgrande.com](http://www.naplesgrande.com/) .
